ns2:section.sectionText: PLEASE NOTE: THIS COURSE IS MOSTLY SELF-PACED, BUT CLASS WILL MEET IN FACE-TO-FACE FORMAT ON AUGUST 27 AND OCTOBER 15. First class meeting is August 27; last class/national certification exam is October 15. Registration is restricted to Hospitality Management and Dietetic majors until after junior registration, and then remaining seats open to all majors. FSHN minors must contact the department office for registration authorization (333-1324). TO BE ADDED TO A WAIT LIST FOR THIS CLASS, go to www.fshn.uiuc.edu and click on "Info for Current Students" and then on "Waitlist Information."
